subject: Request for Conditional No-PO Onboarding — LedgerBridge Integration Trial
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@ledgerbridge.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LedgerBridge trial + onboarding — invoice path question

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — LedgerBridge is excited to pilot our ledger-integration with Redwood for a three-month trial. Before we get legal and procurement moving, a quick question on billing: can Redwood accept invoices from LedgerBridge for the trial period without a Purchase Order? Our procurement cycle can be a blocker on our side and the pilot is time-sensitive.

Attached: LedgerBridge_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW, trial scope)

If a temporary invoice-only path is possible (with caps or pre-conditions), that would speed things up. Happy to route anything needed to procurement@ledgerbridge.com.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Partnerships, LedgerBridge
https://ledgerbridge.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@ledgerbridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerBridge trial + onboarding — invoice path question

Alex — thanks for the SOW and for the quick follow. Appreciate the urgency. Short answer: we do have a PO-first policy for most new vendors, but procurement and finance will sometimes approve conditional invoice-only onboarding for short pilots under specific controls.

Proposed conditions we typically need for invoice-only onboarding (pilot):
- Cap on total invoiced value for the pilot (we usually set $15k or less)
- Completed vendor intake form and tax docs (W-9)
- Single-invoice or monthly-invoice cadence; no recurring auto-renews until PO established
- Assigned Redwood account lead and a defined end date for the trial

Ben / Priya — can you weigh in on whether we can accept LedgerBridge under these conditions? If yes, I’d like to confirm terms to Alex and provide the vendor intake form.

Alex — I attached our intake template for speed. If you can return that + W-9 and a signed SOW, we can fast-track finance review.

Attachment: Vendor_Intake_Form_Marissa.pdf

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerBridge trial + onboarding — invoice path question

Marissa / Priya — finance here. We can support an invoice-only onboarding for the trial subject to controls. My suggested guardrails:

- Dollar cap: $12,500 for the three-month pilot (covers typical small pilots)
- Payment terms: Net 30 after invoice receipt; single invoice preferred
- Vendor risk sign-off: complete intake form + verification of corporate bank and W-9
- No contract auto-renew: explicit non-renewal clause for pilot invoices
- Escrow or prepayment if the vendor is overseas or payment risk is flagged

If the SOW value is over $12,500, we either require: (a) PO, or (b) prepayment for the pilot portion. Also, we will record the vendor as ‘conditional-invoice-only’ in AP for 90 days and trigger a procurement follow-up for PO onboarding.

I attached a one-page vendor evidence checklist we use.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Finance — Vendor Payments
From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.example>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LedgerBridge trial + onboarding — invoice path question

Looping in procurement/ops perspective. A few operational notes before we confirm to the vendor: 

- Require vendor allowlist entry (temporary) with a maximum invoice cap tied to the intake form.
- We need audit evidence: admin user list, SLA for data retention, and confirmation that no sensitive PII will be exported during the pilot.
- If LedgerBridge requires any elevated network access for integration, this must be approved by infra and logged.

I can approve this as a conditional exception pending: signed SOW, completed intake form, W-9, and confirmation of max invoice. After intake is complete, I will route a short procurement approval to our VP of Ops.

Priya Natarajan
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@ledgerbridge.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Cc: procurement@ledgerbridge.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerBridge trial + onboarding — invoice path question

Thanks Marissa, Ben, Priya — we appreciate the clarity and the proposed controls. LedgerBridge is happy to proceed under the conditional invoice-only path with the following confirmations:

- Trial max invoiced value: $12,500 (agreed)
- Payment terms: Net 30, single invoice for the pilot period
- Intake form: we will complete and return this morning
- W-9 and signed SOW: attached (Signed_SOW_LedgerBridge.pdf)

We do not require any privileged network access beyond tokenized API keys; no PII will be exported during the integration.

Next steps from our side: procurement@ledgerbridge.com will send the completed intake and W-9; please confirm where to send the invoice once the pilot starts.

Regards,
Alex

2) Redwood procurement (Priya) performs allowlist + evidence check (SLA/data retention confirmation).
3) Finance (Ben) will mark vendor as conditional-invoice-only and accept pilot invoice up to $12,500.
4) LedgerBridge sends single invoice to ap@redwood.example with reference LDGB-TRIAL-2028-07.
5) Pilot live window: 2028-07-15 -> 2028-10-15 (90 days).

Please reply-all to confirm and I’ll open a short HubSpot deal record and one-line procurement approval for VP sign-off. We’ll treat this as a temporary exception and follow up with PO onboarding if the integration expands.
